name: Kewell Soresi
original_name: キューエル・ソレイシィ
source:
Kewell Soresi is an officer of the Britannian Army. Kewell belongs to the Purebloods and stands by Jeremiah's side in scapegoating Suzaku Kururugi. When Jeremiah's incomprehensible actions lead to Suzaku's escape with Zero, he leads the rest of the Purebloods in an unsuccessful attempt to kill Jeremiah. He is killed by Kallen in the Battle of Narita. He has a younger sister named Marika (マリーカ) who serves as one of the Valkyrie Squadron pilots in the second season. 

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Code_Geass_characters#Britannian_Army]Wikipedia[/url].]
